description: List replies under one root comment on Bilibili content.

content_id.description: ID of the content the root comment belongs to.

content_type.description: Content type: video, article, dynamic, audio, album, course, or a numeric Bilibili reply type.

limit.description: Maximum number of replies to return (default 20).

root_rpid.description: ID (rpid) of the root comment to list replies under.

name: get_content_comment_replies
